titles.title: The Duke of Hermont's Male Mistress

description:
Vitor Hermont, head of the prestigious Hermont ducal family and a young admiral guarding the seas of Lostria, became the new master of the Elysia estate.

Roy, who had been crossdressing and working as the estate’s gamekeeper, tries to avoid him upon realizing that the new master is the very man she had spent a night with.

“Well, yeah… it doesn’t have to be a woman.”

Should she feel relieved she wasn’t recognized?

“Want to be my lover?”

“B-but I’m a man!”

“I know. That’s why I’m asking. I need a male lover.”

Or should he consider it unfortunate?

“It’ll be more scandalous that way.”

She should have run the moment she heard that infamous playboy mutter those words… words that could charm even other men.

“Wait… do you mean you like me even though I’m a man?”

“Gender doesn’t matter to me anymore. Whether you’re a man with the same equipment or just a gamekeeper, I’ve been dying to have you.”

What started as a contract for mutual benefit soon turned into a tidal wave that swept them both away.
